thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] PROD P99 spike detected for Harmony-Enterprise (vpc:harmony-eu-west-1). metric=p99_latency value=3.2s SLO=1.2s. Impact: checkout latency increased. Dashboards: https://dash.redwood.internal/r/harmony/1719004321 :rotating_light:
oncall-robin: acked, joining. Paging SRE/Eng. Starting ad-hoc war room. Who's on customer comms?
acct-sam: I'm on customer comms — calling Harmony infra lead now (Melody). Will update.
sre-jen: quick triage: dedicated pool "harmony-eu-west-1-ded" shows queue_length jump x3, one host (node-14) NVMe iowait high, CPU at 92%. KV cache miss rate spiked ~5x -> cold-cache. Hot shard on model-v3-q4 (shard 7) hitting heavy tail. Suspect tenant-originated batch job + increased user traffic.
eng-lee: suggested immediate mitigations (short):
- throttle tenant traffic to 50r/s
- apply routing override to shift ~30% traffic to warm spare in eu-west-2
- if needed, spin up 2 warm workers in this pool (scaling will be ~7-10m)
Commands:
```
/redwoodctl tenants throttle --tenant harmony-123 --rate 50
/redwoodctl routing set-override --tenant harmony-123 --region eu-west-2 --pct 30 --reason "p99 spike"
/redwoodctl pool scale --pool harmony-eu-west-1-ded +2 --priority emergency
```
deploy-bot: routing override started: shift=30% -> eu-west-2 (run id: r-1719004359).
sre-jen: applied tenant throttle (50r/s). Observing p99 drop from 3.2s -> 1.8s within 90s. Node-14 IO still high, offloading started by routing override. Cache priming job suggested.
acct-sam: Harmony on call: Melody says checkout is still flaky but sees some improvement. They paused nightly analytics job. Asking for ETA to full recovery.
eng-lee: ETA for stabilization ~10-20m if offload holds and cache warms. Will prioritize shard rebalancing post-stable.
sre-jen: kicked runbook step: evict hot shard from node-14 -> reassign to spare node (eviction job id: ev-1719004410). Monitoring KV cache priming (prefill) for the tenant.
deploy-bot: ev-1719004410 complete. Shard reassigned to node-21.
sre-jen: p99 now ~1.35s, p95 ~0.72s. Still above SLO but trending down. Continuing to monitor for 2x window.
customer-liaison-maya: logged incident with Harmony, sent interim status note. They'll keep traffic steady and report any residual errors. They asked for a post-incident summary and root cause.
acct-sam: scheduled customer follow-up in 30m with summary and remediation steps.
oncall-robin: handing primary follow-up to eng-lee for deeper investigation and remediation items (shard assignment, eviction heuristics, cache warming). I'll take ownership of the incident ticket and postmortem coordination. Created ticket INC-2026-1721 and linked traces/metrics.
eng-lee: will own root cause analysis and remediation plan. Likely action items: better shard hotness detection, pre-warming for known heavy tenants, automated temporary routing fallback, and tenant-level soft quotas.
sre-jen: adding notes to runbook: ensure we have warm spare capacity per region, add a quick-run cache-priming job. Leaving war room once p99 < 1.2s for 5m sustained.
oncall-robin: thumbs up. If things regress, page SRE again and re-open war room.
acct-sam: will send customer update in 10m.
customer-liaison-maya: Harmony appreciates the quick response. Requested timeline for postmortem by EOD.
eng-lee: ack, will deliver RCA draft by EOD.
incident-bot: [RESOLVE-CANDIDATE] p99 trending down below threshold, awaiting 5m stable window.
oncall-robin: closing war room in 12m unless any regression. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
